name: 2015-16 Guidance Counselor Reporting - Social Worker Data
description:
This dataset contains 2015-16 school-level reporting on social worker staffing in New York City public schools, with one row per school building (identified by DBN and location name). It covers 1,644 schools and includes the school type (elementary, high school, junior high/intermediate/middle, K-8, secondary, and others), a combined total of social workers and guidance counselors, and a total social worker count. Staffing is further broken down into full-time, part-time, bilingual, and staff serving more than one location, plus a flag for assigned teachers on reserve (ATR). Many breakdown fields use "No Data" where schools did not report a value, so counts should be interpreted with that in mind.

The data can be used to examine how social work resources are distributed across schools and school types, compare staffing levels between buildings, and identify schools with limited, part-time, or shared support staff. It supports equity and resource-allocation analysis, school-level
